topic: Using a Coupon at the Grocery Checkout

script.title: THE EXPIRED COUPON
script.scene_zh: 超市收銀台 · 使用優惠券
script.story_hook: An expired coupon nearly stops the checkout line.
script.intro_zh: 一張過期優惠券差點讓結帳出問題。
script.welcome_en: Hi everyone, welcome back! Today a coupon causes tiny trouble.
script.welcome_zh: 哈囉，歡迎回來！今天一張優惠券惹出小麻煩。
script.outro: That's a wrap, friends. Listen again and repeat along!
script.outro_zh: 今天就到這裡！再聽一遍，跟著唸一次。
script.practice_intro_en: Now it's your turn, echo each sentence after me.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在換你，跟著我一句一句朗讀。
script.char_a_description: a woman in her forties with short curly auburn hair, wearing a lavender cardigan and round reading glasses on a beaded cord, carrying a woven market basket
script.char_b_description: a slim man in his early twenties with a shaved head and a gold stud earring, wearing a lime green cashier vest over a plain white tee, bouncing on his heels as he talks
script.youtube_title: 【🧾優惠券實戰英文】🛒「到期怎麼辦」⚠️店長核准、改價、結帳一次聽懂｜Grocery Coupon English

Follow Dana as she presents a paper coupon, asks the manager for an override, and pays in style — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA. The second half is line-by-line repeat practice, so the phrases stick today.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🧾優惠券英文｜核對優惠券・請店長核准・結帳付款｜聽完就會用｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
優惠券過期，站在收銀台前尷尬到不行？
店長核准這種話用英文到底怎麼講？

這一集帶大家走進超市收銀台，Dana 拿著一張香草酸奶的優惠券結帳，才發現上個週末已經到期。她從出示紙本券、聽店員打電話請示，到最後刷卡完成付款，全程都是自然的美式口語。

你會聽到：
🧾 使用優惠券：例如「Can I use this paper coupon today?」。
⏳ 面對過期狀況：例如「this one expired last weekend」。
🛒 核准與結帳：例如「you can override it yourself, right?」、「That'll be eighteen forty.」

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次拿優惠券結帳，記得對店員笑一笑，英雄就在你心裡！
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a paper coupon at the register

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, can I use this paper coupon today?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ kæn aɪ juːz ðɪs ˈpeɪpər ˈkuːpɑn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，今天可以用這張紙本優惠券嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, let me see. What's it for?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr lɛt mi siː wʌts ɪt fɔːr/
dialogue.zh: 可以，給我看一下。這是折抵什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two dollars off the vanilla yogurt, see?
dialogue.phonetic: /tuː ˈdɑːlərz ɔːf ðə vəˈnɪlə ˈjoʊɡərt siː/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, this one expired last weekend, ma'am.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm ðɪs wʌn ɪkˈspaɪərd læst ˈwiːkˌɛnd mæm/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，這張上個週末就過期了喔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you sure? I printed it yesterday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ʃʊr aɪ ˈprɪntɪd ɪt ˈjɛstərˌdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 你確定嗎？我昨天才列印的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, the code still works. Let me try.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ðə koʊd stɪl wɜːrks lɛt mi traɪ/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，條碼還掃得起來。讓我試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do. I hate fighting over two dollars.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliːz duː aɪ heɪt ˈfaɪtɪŋ ˈoʊvər tuː ˈdɑːlərz/
dialogue.zh: 拜託了，我可不想為了兩塊錢起爭執。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, it scanned! But I need a quick call.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ɪt skænd bʌt aɪ niːd ə kwɪk kɔːl/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，掃進去了！不過我得先打一通電話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, you can override it yourself, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ju kæn ˌoʊvərˈaɪd ɪt jɜːrˈsɛlf raɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，你自己就能改價，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not expired ones. My manager approves those.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɪkˈspaɪərd wʌnz maɪ ˈmænɪdʒər əˈpruːvz ðoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 過期的不行，這種要店長核准。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, no rush. I'll wait right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ noʊ rʌʃ aɪl weɪt raɪt hɪr/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All set, she said yes this once.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔːl sɛt ʃi sɛd jɛs ðɪs wʌns/
dialogue.zh: 搞定了，店長這次同意了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，你根本就是我的大英雄！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, that happens more than you'd think.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðæt ˈhæpənz mɔːr ðæn juːd θɪŋk/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，這種事比你想像的還多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I'll check the date first, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪl tʃɛk ðə deɪt fɜːrst ˈɑːnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 下次我一定先檢查到期日。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan. That'll be eighteen forty.
dialogue.zh: 這樣很好。一共十八塊四。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Card, please. And keep the receipt, okay?
dialogue.phonetic: /kɑːrd pliːz ənd kiːp ðə rɪˈsiːt oʊˈkeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 刷卡，謝謝。收據請留一張給我，可以吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done! Here's your bag, have a good one.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn hɪrz jʊr bæɡ hæv ə ɡʊd wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 完成！這是你的袋子，祝你愉快！
